results.objective: Verify PORTIDE application loads successfully and landing page is interactive.
results.actions: 1. Navigate to http://localhost:3000/. 2. Verify page body, brand title, and login CTA.
results.expected_result: PORTIDE application loads successfully, landing page visible, no fatal errors.
results.actual_result: Application loaded successfully in 3651 ms. Landing page rendered with hero section and active login button.
results.remarks: Landing page loaded cleanly without console errors or crash screens.

results.objective: Verify the PORTIDE Login page loads properly and all input controls are functional.
results.preconditions: PORTIDE web application active at http://localhost:3000.
results.actions: 1. Navigate to /login. 2. Verify visibility of email field, password field, and submit button.
results.expected_result: Login page loads correctly and required controls (email, password, submit button) are available.
results.actual_result: Login page rendered successfully. Email input, password input, and Sign In button are visible and interactive.
results.remarks: Form controls are accessible and responsive.

results.objective: Verify valid Port Administrator account logs in successfully and reaches admin dashboard.
results.preconditions: Existing Port Administrator test account present in database.
results.actions: 1. Open /login. 2. Enter valid credentials. 3. Click Sign In. 4. Wait for dashboard redirect.
results.expected_result: Port Administrator successfully logs into the correct PORTIDE dashboard.
results.actual_result: Authentication succeeded in 2402 ms. User navigated to http://localhost:3000/admin/dashboard with active Port Administrator session.
results.remarks: Existing Port Administrator test account used. Authentication and role dashboard resolution succeeded.

results.objective: Verify system rejects non-existing email with appropriate feedback and denies access.
results.actions: 1. Enter nonexistent email. 2. Enter password. 3. Click Sign In. 4. Check response.
results.expected_result: Invalid/non-existing email is rejected. User does not enter dashboard.
results.actual_result: Rejected as expected. Error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password.'. Route remained /login.
results.remarks: Invalid email rejection confirmed. No session tokens were issued.

results.objective: Verify incorrect password for an existing account is rejected and access denied.
results.preconditions: Valid user email 'admin@portide.com' exists in database.
results.actions: 1. Enter existing email. 2. Enter incorrect password. 3. Click Sign In. 4. Verify rejection.
results.expected_result: Incorrect password is rejected. Dashboard does not open. Error feedback appears.
results.actual_result: Authentication rejected as expected. Error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password.'. Route remained /login.
results.remarks: Invalid password properly rejected by backend authentication service.

results.objective: Verify submission of empty email and password fields is rejected by validation.
results.actions: 1. Clear email and password inputs. 2. Click Sign In. 3. Check client validation state.
results.expected_result: Empty login form is rejected by validation. Dashboard is not opened.
results.actual_result: Empty submission blocked by form validation. checkValidity() returned False. No navigation or session created.
results.remarks: Required form input attributes prevented empty payload transmission.

results.objective: Verify Port Administrator receives exclusively the correct Admin dashboard and navigation modules.
results.actions: 1. Inspect current dashboard route. 2. Verify header title. 3. Check sidebar modules. 4. Verify role isolation.
results.expected_result: Port Administrator receives only the correct Admin dashboard.
results.actual_result: Verified Port Administrator dashboard at http://localhost:3000/admin/dashboard. Header, overview cards, and sidebar modules match admin role exclusively.
results.remarks: Role-based access control and layout isolation confirmed.

results.objective: Verify authenticated session remains valid and active after normal browser refresh.
results.actions: 1. Trigger browser refresh. 2. Wait for reload. 3. Check URL and session retention.
results.expected_result: Authenticated session should remain valid after a normal browser refresh. User should not be unexpectedly logged out.
results.actual_result: Session retained across refresh. User remained on http://localhost:3000/admin/dashboard without re-authenticating.
results.remarks: LocalStorage persistence mechanism maintained the session flawlessly across browser refresh.

results.objective: Verify clicking Logout terminates the authenticated session and redirects to the login screen.
results.preconditions: Active Port Administrator session on dashboard.
results.actions: 1. Click header Logout button. 2. Wait for navigation. 3. Check localStorage and login form.
results.expected_result: Logout works successfully. Authentication session is cleared, user is redirected to Login.
results.actual_result: Logout completed successfully in 3262 ms. User redirected to http://localhost:3000/login, session cleared from storage.
results.remarks: Logout cleanly revoked local session and displayed login screen.

results.objective: Verify direct navigation to protected dashboard route after logout is prevented.
results.actions: 1. Directly navigate to /admin/dashboard. 2. Verify ProtectedRoute guard redirects to /login.
results.expected_result: Protected routes remain protected after logout. User is redirected to Login.
results.actual_result: Protected route guard blocked direct access and redirected user to http://localhost:3000/login. Login page displayed.
results.remarks: Client-side routing guard (ProtectedRoute) correctly enforces authentication boundary.
